first_numba_adapter: Unmodified archived _numba_sampen_delay kernel, called in a compiled prange channel loop; batch validation/radius calculation included. JIT warm-up excluded.
first_c_adapter: Unmodified archived C binary, via current ctypes wrapper with algorithm=tree. Original C ABI has no integer-count output; entropy is validated.
kdtree_adapter: Aligned first reference definition; two KDTree radius counts per channel; persistent thread pool.
latest_c: Current compiled backend, algorithm=auto, entropy-only public call for timing.
correctness: Every timed entropy vector allclose to aligned KDTree (rtol=atol=1e-12). Latest uint64 counts equal independently computed KDTree counts for all 64 channels. The historical Numba/C APIs return entropy only, so raw historical counts are not claimed.
preprocessing: Complete pinned 300 Hz recording resampled with resample_poly(5,6), butter(N=4,bandpass=[8,13],output=sos), sosfiltfilt on full recording, first 180 seconds afterward.
timing: Whole channel batch; wrappers, validation, radius computation, allocations and computation included. Reading, preprocessing, imports, JIT, and full-batch warm-up excluded. Randomized method order, seed=640180. All methods use the same four-thread budget.
compiler: Both C libraries: gcc -O3 -std=c11 -fPIC -shared -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fopenmp; no fast-math/march=native
